approval_required_before_tests_or_code: Root review of exact frozen design and failure matrix
test_first_order: Author synthetic target boundary/default-tier table tests for all applicable matrix cases before production edits
Author fixed three-source meta aggregation/finalization/default-tier tests before production edits
Run RED and retain compile success plus intended assertion failures; do not treat compile failures as behavioral RED
Implement the smallest approved seam; retain unchanged test blob hashes
Run focused GREEN, then affected packages and focused race checks
Run applicable named checks by resolving the frozen policy catalog; retain exact argv/environment/limits and status
Review exact diff independently along Standards and Spec; resolve findings without overwriting prior records

in_memory_test_constraints.http: Injected http.RoundTripper returns synthetic http.Response and bounded Readers; no httptest server or TCP
in_memory_test_constraints.time: Pre-canceled/past-deadline or deterministic context fixture; no real sleeps or elapsed-time simulations
in_memory_test_constraints.joining: Channel barriers, completion-index permutations and fixed call counters; no additional production goroutines
in_memory_test_constraints.privacy: Synthetic secret-rich sentinels only, no retained runtime raw scrape/body/error in tests; assert no new Error formatting
in_memory_test_constraints.bounds: Generated/lazy bodies and line/series cases; existing HTTP/parser limits unchanged

proposed_go_commands.purpose: Focused concurrency/privacy/error-chain race tests after names are fixed

FLOW_update_rule: If FLOW changes, use canonical flowcheck render --write-index then the named flow-doc-contracts check; do not copy a check command into another machine authority
expected_operator_docs: Root CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry for new bounded failure diagnostic
Applicable FLOW and canonical index if made inaccurate
proof_requirements: Before-code failure matrix, RED/GREEN/race logs with exact commands and bounded retained outputs
No success/no-body validation or existing failure classification changes
All three source errors retained only in private fixed array; aggregate errors.Is sees only old harness sentinel
Existing parent context and injected product-sentinel regressions pass
Source ordered masks and closed kinds survive only the Bounded projection
Explicit test counts/failures/skips and unchanged no-final-report semantics
Safe allowlist and SHA256SUMS excluding arbitrary errors, response bodies, runtime identities, binaries and private data
not_authorized_by_this_design: Any workload start or server request
Changing timeouts/retries/body/parser bounds, gates or verdict/report validity
Capturing raw failed-round bodies without a separately reviewed plan
